name: Build Rais APK

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      zip_name:
        description: 'Tên file ZIP muốn build (để trống = tự chọn ZIP mới nhất ở thư mục gốc)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
  push:
    paths:
      - '*.zip'
      - '.github/workflows/build-android-apk.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      HAS_RELEASE_KEY: ${{ secrets.RAIS_KEYSTORE_BASE64 != '' }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Set up Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: 'platform-tools,platforms;android-35,build-tools;35.0.0'

      - name: Install Gradle 8.7
        run: |
          wget -q https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.7-bin.zip -O "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip"
          unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle-8.7/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Select ZIP project
        id: select_zip
        shell: bash
        env:
          REQUESTED_ZIP: ${{ inputs.zip_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [[ -n "${REQUESTED_ZIP//[[:space:]]/}" ]]; then
            # Accept a file name only, not a path outside the repository root.
            ZIP_NAME="$(basename "$REQUESTED_ZIP")"
            if [[ "$ZIP_NAME" != "$REQUESTED_ZIP" || "$ZIP_NAME" != *.zip ]]; then
              echo "Input must be the ZIP file name in the repository root, e.g. Rais.zip"
              exit 1
            fi
            if [[ ! -f "$ZIP_NAME" ]]; then
              echo "ZIP file not found in repository root: $ZIP_NAME"
              echo "ZIP files available:"
              find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*.zip' -printf '%f\n' | sort || true
              exit 1
            fi
          else
            # Select the root-level ZIP whose latest commit touching that file is newest.
            ZIP_NAME=""
            LATEST_TIME=0
            while IFS= read -r candidate; do
              [[ -n "$candidate" ]] || continue
              commit_time="$(git log -1 --format=%ct -- "$candidate" || true)"
              [[ -n "$commit_time" ]] || commit_time=0
              if (( commit_time > LATEST_TIME )); then
                LATEST_TIME="$commit_time"
                ZIP_NAME="$candidate"
              fi
            done < <(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*.zip' -printf '%f\n')

            if [[ -z "$ZIP_NAME" ]]; then
              echo "No ZIP files found in the repository root."
              exit 1
            fi
          fi

          echo "Selected ZIP: $ZIP_NAME"
          echo "zip_name=$ZIP_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Unzip selected project
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir rais-project
          unzip -q "${{ steps.select_zip.outputs.zip_name }}" -d rais-project

          # Support either a ZIP with project files at its root or one containing a single project folder.
          if [[ ! -f rais-project/settings.gradle && ! -f rais-project/settings.gradle.kts ]]; then
            candidate="$(find rais-project -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name settings.gradle -o -name settings.gradle.kts \) -print -quit)"
            if [[ -z "$candidate" ]]; then
              echo "Could not find settings.gradle in the selected ZIP."
              echo "The ZIP must contain a Gradle Android project."
              exit 1
            fi
            project_dir="$(dirname "$candidate")"
            mkdir rais-project-root
            cp -a "$project_dir"/. rais-project-root/
            rm -rf rais-project
            mv rais-project-root rais-project
          fi

          test -f rais-project/app/build.gradle -o -f rais-project/app/build.gradle.kts

      - name: Configure persistent signing key
        if: env.HAS_RELEASE_KEY == 'true'
        env:
          KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.RAIS_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.RAIS_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.RAIS_KEY_ALIAS }}
          KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.RAIS_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          echo "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rais-release.jks"
          echo "RAIS_KEYSTORE_FILE=$RUNNER_TEMP/rais-release.jks" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "RAIS_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD=$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "RAIS_KEY_ALIAS=$KEY_ALIAS" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "RAIS_KEY_PASSWORD=$KEY_PASSWORD" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Build signed release APK
        if: env.HAS_RELEASE_KEY == 'true'
        working-directory: rais-project
        run: gradle assembleRelease --stacktrace

      - name: Build debug APK (test only; configure release key for stable updates)
        if: env.HAS_RELEASE_KEY != 'true'
        working-directory: rais-project
        run: gradle assembleDebug --stacktrace

      - name: Upload signed release APK
        if: env.HAS_RELEASE_KEY == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Rais-release-apk
          path: rais-project/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Upload debug APK (test only)
        if: env.HAS_RELEASE_KEY != 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Rais-debug-test-only
          path: rais-project/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
